summary: Iteration 23 — retest of the settings-loaded guard fix for the chat-lock cold-gate regression. ALL THREE TARGET SCENARIOS NOW PASS. (1) PRIMARY (lock-from-inside-chat): tapping 'Lock this chat' in the profile modal → entering PIN 1234 → Confirm → composer + chat content REMAIN VISIBLE, no bounce, NO ChatLockGate, profile label flips to 'Chat locked / Requires PIN to open from chat list', backend persists locked_thread_ids=[threadId]. (2) COLD-GATE THREAD: with locked_thread_ids=[threadId] and lock_chat_tab=false, hard-reloading /chat/<threadId> shows the brief loading state followed by ChatLockGate at t≈0.7s; entering 1234 transitions to chat content (composer + history). (3) COLD-GATE TAB: with lock_chat_tab=true, hard-reloading /chat shows the gate; entering 1234 reveals the chat list (Slang-Connect / Find / threads). The fix (settings-loaded guard in BOTH /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:220-228 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:364-372 — returning an ActivityIndicator until wpSettings.settings !== null, then evaluating the lock gate, then conditionally flipping sessionShownRef) correctly resolves the iter22 regression WITHOUT breaking the iter22 primary win. Required: `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` after deploy because metro CI mode does not hot-reload; an initial run before restart returned stale code and reproduced the regression, but post-restart all three flows pass. No new react-native issues. Backend endpoints unchanged & green.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:220-228 — settings-loaded guard correctly returns an ActivityIndicator BEFORE evaluating isThreadLocked() and BEFORE touching sessionShownRef. This is the right invariant: the ref must never flip until we KNOW (from real backend settings) the thread is unlocked.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:364-372 — mirror guard in ChatTabGate is symmetric and correct.

Cleanliness — the early-return loader is a tiny full-screen ActivityIndicator centered in a SafeAreaView, identical pattern in both files. Consider extracting to a shared <ChatGateLoader/> in src/ if more callers appear; current duplication (≈10 lines) is acceptable.

/app/frontend/src/chat-settings.tsx:71 — `settings` still initialized to null and silently means 'not loaded yet'. Consumers must keep handling the null phase; consider a future-cleanup `loaded: boolean` flag, but not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Lock-cold-gate is fully fixed across all three target scenarios. The two settings-loaded guards in chat/[id].tsx and (tabs)/chat.tsx are the canonical pattern — do not remove them. If future iterations add new gate consumers, apply the same pattern: (a) early-return a loader while settings is null, (b) evaluate isXxxLocked only after settings is non-null, (c) only flip sessionShownRef inside an `if (!locked)` branch (or after a confirmed unlock). REMEMBER: `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` after editing app/* in this CI-mode metro setup. Login token field is `token` (not `access_token`). RN-Web TouchableOpacity playwright clicks still need the JS-dispatchEvent (mousedown+mouseup+click) workaround.
